comment: The Go test shards of the ci-go.yml Test job. scripts/ci/go-test-shards.mjs reads this file; its header gives the rules. The most specific pattern wins, and the shard with the pattern "..." gets every package that no other shard names.

shards.name: db-storage
shards.description: The PostgreSQL repository suite (the longest package) and the storage suites that need the S3, Azure and GCS emulators.

shards.name: api-core
shards.description: The four slowest API packages after repos: the router package and the eliteacore, configurations and mcp handlers.

shards.name: api-app
shards.description: The other API packages and the application layer.

shards.name: rest
shards.description: Every package that no other shard names: the migration corpus, testpg, tests/system, the rest of elitea-main and every other workspace module.
